abstract: Connect Aider to self-hosted and gateway models. Covers install and upgrades, OPENAI_API_BASE with the openai/ prefix, ollama_chat and Anthropic base URLs, .env key handling, model metadata and model settings files, edit formats, reasoning tags, per-engine setup for vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, llama-swap and LiteLLM, troubleshooting, and an endpoint probe script.
